params.body:
Closes #1140

The warranty route `real-garant/{id}` sits outside the `auth` middleware because the warranty block on a garage's website and on the public stock list loads it without a login, with the garage in `dId`. Every other caller (offer, order form, contract) sends no `dId` and relies on the signed-in dealer. Without a login, `show()` read `Auth::user()->dealer_id` on null and gave a 500 (Nightwatch 81, 2026-11-26 08:47, one occurrence). `calculate()` had the same read without a guard.

What changes:
- `show()` lets a guest through only with `dId` and the `website` or `stocklist` view. Anything else throws an `AuthenticationException`: a 401 for an AJAX call, a redirect to the login otherwise. The exception handler already leaves that exception unreported, so it no longer reaches Nightwatch.
- `calculate()` always asks for a login.
- New rule R P2-7.10 and finding `2026-11-26-de-garantieroute-las-de-dealer-van-niemand`.

The public uses are unchanged: `website/detail.blade.php` and `stocklist/_tabs/warranty/warranty.blade.php` both send `dId` and a public view.

Tests: `TheWarrantyRouteAsksAGuestToSignInTest` covers six cases: a guest AJAX call gets a 401, a guest page goes to the login, `dId` with the contract view still gets a 401, the website and stocklist blocks still load, a guest cannot price a programme, and a signed-in dealer is unchanged. Full suite and phpstan ran locally before proposing.
params.title: Warranty route asks a guest to sign in instead of a 500 (Nightwatch 81)
